definitions: To verbally abuse someone using a wide range of insults.
To use many different derogatory terms to describe someone.
examples: She started to call every name in the book when he broke her favorite vase.
He was so angry, he began to call every name in the book at the referee.
Don't call every name in the book just because you lost the game.
lemma: call every name in the book
source: call every name in the book
